evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.isolation_confirmed: No file under src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/ was read; no diff, plan, or git history was consulted. Only data/** and docs/math-foundations.md from the export were opened.

leaf_classification.kind: derived snapshot self-statistic (bookkeeping), NOT a physics quantity
leaf_classification.reasoning: The leaf lives under the pseudo-scenario '<snapshot metadata>' -> 'fingerprint'. Its referent is the golden snapshot artifact itself: a tally of how many numeric leaves the captured snapshot contains. It does not name a champion, item, rune, stat, or formula, and therefore has no antecedent in the cached wiki text or in any identity stated in docs/math-foundations.md.

independent_computation.method: Exhaustive search of the permitted evidence tree for any ground truth that fixes this leaf, followed by a structural (correct-by-construction) argument once no such ground truth was found.

searches_run.search: case-insensitive grep for 'fingerprint' and 'numeric_leaves' / 'numeric leaves' across the ENTIRE exported tree (data/** and docs/math-foundations.md)

searches_run.result: the golden snapshot is referenced only as an external regression-pin artifact produced by scripts/golden_snapshot.py (lines 21, 320, 427-437, 477). No leaf-count, schema, or fingerprint semantics are stated anywhere in the document.

searches_run.search: enumerated every data/ subtree for a golden-corpus-shaped artifact: atoms/, bin/, champion-audit/, item-atoms/, practice-corpus/, wiki/, wiki-atoms/, worklists/, plus champions.json, items.json, runes.json, staleness.json, onhit-matrix.json, economics-sourced.json
searches_run.result: data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json is the Practice-Tool verification corpus (input tuples + in-game-verifiable expectations); it carries no fingerprint block and no leaf tally. No file in data/ mirrors, counts, or constrains the golden snapshot's leaf population.

independent_computation.conclusion_of_search: There is NO wiki-sourced number and NO quoted formula in docs/math-foundations.md from which 8349 or 8312 can be derived. The value is not independently recomputable from the permitted evidence, by construction of what the leaf is.

structural_argument.premise_1: A fingerprint field is computed by the snapshot writer FROM the snapshot it is embedded in. It is a mirror of the artifact, not an independent assertion about the game.
structural_argument.premise_2: The only failure mode available to a self-derived tally is staleness: the artifact changes while the tally does not. A stale tally manifests as a leaf that did NOT move when leaves around it did.
structural_argument.premise_3: This leaf demonstrably moved (8349 -> 8312), so the staleness failure mode is ruled out: the fingerprint was recomputed at capture time against the new snapshot.
structural_argument.premise_4: 8349 is a true statement about the OLD snapshot and a false statement about the NEW one; 8312 is the recomputed tally of the artifact actually being pinned.
structural_argument.conclusion: For the snapshot under test, 8312 is the correct value of this leaf. This leaf cannot itself be the locus of a numeric error.

independent_computation.arithmetic_note: 8349 - 8312 = 37. The magnitude is consistent with a bounded set of numeric outputs (37 numbers) leaving the snapshot; nothing in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md contradicts or corroborates that count, because neither source describes snapshot shape.

caveats_for_the_reviewer: This verdict is CONDITIONAL and narrow: it certifies only that 8312 correctly describes the snapshot that was captured. It does NOT certify that the snapshot SHOULD have lost 37 numeric leaves.

The substantive question — whether those 37 numbers were legitimately removed or wrongly dropped — is carried entirely by the other changed leaves. This metadata leaf is a mirror and will faithfully report either a correct or an incorrect snapshot.

If the change under test was intended to be a pure refactor (golden gate semantics require zero diffs for a refactor), a moved fingerprint is itself a signal that behavior changed — but adjudicating intent requires the plan/diff, which this oracle is barred from reading. Escalate that question to a reviewer with diff access.

'old_value_correct' was rejected because 8349 cannot describe the new artifact. 'both_wrong' was rejected because it would require the snapshot writer to miscount its own output, for which there is no evidence in the permitted tree and which would corrupt every fingerprint leaf, not this one.
